segments.caption: A student from Pabna University of Science & Technology performs a dynamic, choreographed flash mob dance on a busy street at the Pabna Bus Terminal, in celebration of the ICC World Twenty20 Bangladesh 2014 tournament. The performance, lasting one minute, features a central dancer in a hat and sunglasses executing energetic moves while a crowd of students watches, all set against the backdrop of everyday traffic and pedestrians.
